///////////////////////////////
marker $$ test *FLS command $$
///////////////////////////////

; --------------------------------------------------
; load fujinet rom
memory load rom #0x8000 "${WS_ROOT}/build/fujinet.rom"
symbols load "${WS_ROOT}/build/fujinet.rom.lbl"

; load in the harness which sets up MOS stubs, and various vectors
memory load atari "${BINARY_PATH}"
symbols load "${SYMBOLS_PATH}"

; remove any cc65 autogenerated symbols from the ROM
symbols remove "__.*"

; mark the ROM as read only
memory protect ro #0xFF00 0x0100

; clean start
registers flush

; initialise the ROM
run $init_harness until (CP = $end_init_harness OR cycle_count > 5000)
assert CP = $end_init_harness $$completed code correctly$$
assert cycle_count <= 2000    $$cycles within accpeptable limit from previous runs$$
; --------------------------------------------------

; Mock ListDirectory response (002 capture, SLIP-framed, 89 bytes).
memory load #0xC000 "${UNIT_TEST_DIR}/data/fls/002_list_directory_root_start0_maxpayload220_resp.bin"
memory write $mock_slip_len 0x(59,00)
run $mock_slip_rewind until (cycle_count > 100)

; Canonical host from 001 ResolvePath capture (tnfs://192.168.1.101/).
memory write $fuji_current_host_len 0x(15)
; PWS page $17 + FUJI_HOST_URI_OFFSET ($168) after init_harness
memory write #0x1868 0x(74,6e,66,73,3a,2f,2f,31,39,32,2e,31,36,38,2e,31,2e,31,30,31,2f,00)

memory write $mock_print_pos 0x(00)

; Run *FLS (no args) — uses current host URI, one ListDirectory page.
run $cmd_fs_flist until ($mock_slip_pos = 0x59 OR cycle_count > 0xFFFF)

assert $mock_slip_pos = 0x59 $$SLIP response fully replayed$$
assert $buffer_ptr -> #0x1700 $$PWS packet at page$$
assert #0x1700 = 0xFE $$decoded FujiBus device id$$
assert #0x1705 = 0x01 $$FujiBus status OK$$

; ListDirectory header in decoded PWS (002 capture).
assert #0x170D = 0x06 $$entry count low$$
assert #0x170F = 0x46 $$entries blob length low$$
assert #0x1713 ~ "atari" $$first compact name: atari$$
